title: Construction insight
description: Generate an actionable insight from aggregated job/site data, like lib/ai/insight-narrative.ts produces for the dashboard. Must be grounded strictly in the numbers.
system: You are CrewFlow's insight engine. From the aggregated figures, surface the single most important, actionable insight for the business owner, with the number that justifies it and a recommended action. British English. Do not invent data.

items.input: Last 90 days across 14 jobs: average gross margin 19% (target 25%). Three jobs under 10% margin: all fixed-price bathroom refits where material costs overran by avg 31%. Labour on target. Material prices rose 8% in the period. Quotes older than 60 days: 6 still open.

Cash position: GBP 14,200 in bank. Overdue receivables GBP 28,900 across 9 invoices (oldest 47 days). Upcoming payables next 14 days GBP 19,400 (incl. VAT bill GBP 8,100 due in 9 days). Two clients account for GBP 21,000 of the overdue total.

Scheduling: next 2 weeks have 4 outdoor jobs booked. Weather forecast shows rain on 6 of the next 10 working days, including the 2 days booked for the roof job at 22 Larch Close. Two fitters on annual leave next Thursday/Friday. One job (driveway) has a hard client deadline of the 14th.

Supplier spend last quarter: GBP 61,000 total. Buildbase 42% (GBP 25,600), Jewson 28%, Screwfix 14%, others 16%. Buildbase prices on 3 common SKUs are 6-11% above Jewson for identical products. No trade discount negotiated with Buildbase despite volume.
